items.reading_block_html: The relation is strong, mixed, and high-pressure: both units reconstruct valid finite cognition without unmediated metaphysical possession, but A Treatise of Human Nature explains objecthood through empirical-relational production while The Critique of Pure Reason validates it through a priori conditions of possible experience.

items.reading_block_html: Scale is symmetrical because both inputs are WB units, but project scope is not: A Treatise of Human Nature extends one recursive machine from cognition through affect and institutions into political resistance, whereas The Critique of Pure Reason concentrates on cognitive jurisdiction and reaches morality and practical orientation only through terminal reassignment.

items.reading_block_html: The governing problem is how perception-bound human nature can generate knowledge, factual reality, selfhood, affective order, property, morality, and political authority without access to substance, intrinsic power, natural right, or an external tribunal.

items.reading_block_html: What remains underdetermined is the ultimate inventory and origin of the specific forms, categories, schemata, and the deeper grounding of practical reason’s terminal authority.
items.reading_html: What remains underdetermined is the ultimate inventory and origin of the specific forms, categories, schemata, and the deeper grounding of practical reason’s terminal authority.
items.reading_text: What remains underdetermined is the ultimate inventory and origin of the specific forms, categories, schemata, and the deeper grounding of practical reason’s terminal authority.
items.text: What remains underdetermined is the ultimate inventory and origin of the specific forms, categories, schemata, and the deeper grounding of practical reason’s terminal authority.

items.reading_block_html: The most resistant element is the controlled non-object: thing in itself, noumenon, unconditioned, supersensible, God, and completion are indispensable but not positively reconstructible as theoretical cognition.
items.reading_html: The most resistant element is the controlled non-object: thing in itself, noumenon, unconditioned, supersensible, God, and completion are indispensable but not positively reconstructible as theoretical cognition.
items.reading_text: The most resistant element is the controlled non-object: thing in itself, noumenon, unconditioned, supersensible, God, and completion are indispensable but not positively reconstructible as theoretical cognition.
items.text: The most resistant element is the controlled non-object: thing in itself, noumenon, unconditioned, supersensible, God, and completion are indispensable but not positively reconstructible as theoretical cognition.

items.reading_block_html: Reconstruction depends on sequence because sensibility must delimit givenness before understanding can legislate experience, and understanding’s termination must precede reason’s dialectical and practical transformations.
items.reading_html: Reconstruction depends on sequence because sensibility must delimit givenness before understanding can legislate experience, and understanding’s termination must precede reason’s dialectical and practical transformations.

items.text: Reconstruction depends on sequence because sensibility must delimit givenness before understanding can legislate experience, and understanding’s termination must precede reason’s dialectical and practical transformations.

items.reading_block_html: Reconstruction also depends on recursive return: every power of reason is first authorized, then bounded, then reassigned to its lawful use.
items.reading_html: Reconstruction also depends on recursive return: every power of reason is first authorized, then bounded, then reassigned to its lawful use.
items.reading_text: Reconstruction also depends on recursive return: every power of reason is first authorized, then bounded, then reassigned to its lawful use.

items.reading_block_html: The indispensable tension is productive rather than defective: reason requires the unconditioned and supersensible, but critique must prevent this requirement from becoming speculative possession.

items.reading_block_html: The whole-book system is preserved only if limitation is treated as generative, contradiction as diagnostic, failure as methodological, and metaphysics as recoded rather than abolished.
